decks.notes: The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to focus on aggressive plays while utilizing tempo to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently. Cards like Wasteland and Daze help to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their progress, while countermagic like Force of Will and removal spells like Lightning Bolt provide additional ways to control the game. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and adaptable in order to stay one step ahead of the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler, while also maintaining control of the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck also utilizes disruptive creatures like Meddling Mage and Bilbo, Thief in the Night to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to control the game and dictate the pace of play.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful ramp spells like Grim Monolith and Expedition Map to quickly reach high mana counts with Cloudpost and Tron lands. The goal is to utilize cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to disrupt your opponent's game plan while setting up win conditions like Kozilek's Command and The One Ring. With a mix of counter spells like Force of Will and proactive disruption, this deck aims to out-value opponents through its efficient mana production and powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, utilizing cards like Reanimate, Shallow Grave, and Animate Dead. Cards like Unmask, Faithless Looting, Thoughtseize, and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own combo pieces. The deck aims to generate a fast and explosive start using cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Polluted Delta to fuel its graveyard-based reanimation strategy. The inclusion of other creatures like Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide alternative win conditions and utility options.

The deck focuses on using Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp up mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells and threats, allowing the player to control the game and overwhelm their opponent. Key cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command provide versatility and disruption, while Sink into Stupor and Force of Will help to control the board. The goal is to establish a dominant board presence and outvalue the opponent with big spells and unstoppable threats like The One Ring and Ugin, Eye of the Storms.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal while utilizing card draw and manipulation to find key pieces. Leyline Binding and Quantum Riddler provide board control, while Tamiyo and Up the Beanstalk offer card advantage. Uro and Phelia can provide additional value and threats. The manabase is designed to support the diverse color requirements of the spells in the deck. Overall, the key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and grind out incremental advantages until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this Bant Control deck is to utilize a combination of counterspells, card advantage, and removal spells to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By efficiently managing resources and using cards like Force of Will, Leyline Binding, and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to outlast opponents and slowly build an advantage. The deck also includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to apply pressure and close out the game once control has been established.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure through aggressive creatures. Using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Recruiter of the Guard to slow down the opponent, while utilizing Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly get threats onto the battlefield. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Skyclave Apparition to deal with opposing threats. The presence of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana quickly with Cloudpost and Tron lands, allowing for powerful plays with high-cost spells and threats. The deck includes a combination of control elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation, along with removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Sink into Stupor. Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms provide additional utility and threats, while The One Ring offers a powerful win condition. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and threats while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on using Doomsday to stack the top of the deck with specific cards, then using cards like Thassa's Oracle and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to win the game on the same turn. It also includes a variety of cantrips, disruption, and acceleration to help set up the combo efficiently. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces and protect the combo from opponent's disruption, leading to a powerful win condition that can close out games in a single turn.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly deploying threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to control the early game with cards like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will, while leveraging cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to apply pressure and close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Cori-Steel Cutter and Unholy Heat provide additional removal options, and cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help improve consistency and card selection. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive tempo strategy, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands for consistency and flexibility.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while also utilizing efficient removal like Fatal Push and Snuff Out. The deck aims to apply pressure through efficient creatures like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, backed up by countermagic like Daze and Force of Negation to protect its threats. The deck also utilizes card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain a consistent game plan. The mana base includes disruptive lands like Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures paired with equipment to control the board and disrupt the opponent's plays. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Recruiter of the Guard, the deck can slow down the opponent while also searching for key pieces like Stoneforge Mystic. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Skyclave Apparition to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of aggressive creatures and equipment.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats quickly to apply pressure. By using a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, and efficient creatures, the deck seeks to control the tempo of the game and prevent the opponent from getting ahead. With cards like Thoughtseize and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck can strip key cards from the opponent's hand and gain card advantage. By maintaining a strong board presence and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck looks to close out games efficiently and decisively.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly bring out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield by casting Show and Tell or Sneak Attack. This combo allows you to bypass your opponent's defenses and deliver a devastating blow. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect your combo pieces, while utilizing cards like Ponder and Brainstorm to find the necessary pieces quickly. With this strategy, you aim to overwhelm your opponent and secure victory before they have a chance to react.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly outpace and overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, as well as mana-fixing from cards like Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls, the deck aims to play large threats like Sire of Seven Deaths and It That Heralds the End at a rapid pace. Additionally, cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer provide disruption and control, allowing the deck to dictate the tempo of the game.
